content.text: Mbarara University of Science and Technology

items: The Super Manager Bottleneck: One person acts as supervisor, cashier, payroll distributor and record keeper.
Unexplained Cash Deficits: Manual computation of cash shortages at the end of the day without a tool to log operational expenses.
Informal Labor Practices: Daily cash payouts based on memory, with no formal attendance tracking.
Data Vulnerability: Records are kept in physical books and on a single local laptop with no cloud backup.
Direct Observation: The laptop was powered on and actively used during the day. A printer is on site and physical receipts were being printed for customers as trucks loaded.
Semi Structured Interview: Conducted with the Sales Manager to understand payment channels (Cash, Mobile Money, Bank), tax filing processes and primary pain points regarding cash insecurity.
Environmental Scan: Customers transport their own goods. Trucks load in bulk. Site has CCTV cameras, indicating baseline security awareness.
The Gatekeeper Effect: The Sales Manager was hesitant to share deep financial workflows, such as exact tax calculations and cash storage protocols.
Inaccessibility: The Business Owner, Site Workers could not be approached directly. These are unresolvable gaps.
No Follow up Feasibility: The Sales Manager was unwilling to provide further information and a return visit to the site is not possible. The project scope is locked.

slides.title: Strategic Business Synthesis
slides.subtitle: How We Bridged the Information Gaps

items: Deficit Root Cause: In cash heavy local SMEs, end of day shortages are rarely theft. They are almost always unrecorded petty cash expenses. The system must allow logging of these expenses to balance the till.

Dual Phase Workflow: Because physical receipts are printed during the day, the system cannot be evening only. It must support real time transaction processing, followed by a dedicated evening reconciliation module.
Remote Access Reality: Since the owner visits daily, a live remote dashboard is unnecessary. Cloud technology is strictly for automated nightly disaster recovery and asynchronous historical review.

Phase 1: Real Time Point of Sale. During the day, the system processes individual sales with multiple product lines, calculates VAT, updates inventory atomically and prints physical receipts after commit.

Phase 2: End of Day Reconciliation. In the evening, the system shows recorded payment activity by channel, logs operational expenses, computes cash variance with opening float, and generates a final daily summary report for the Business Owner.
Excluded Features: Credit and debtors modules are excluded, as the business operates on a strict no credit policy.
Normalization: Database normalized to 3NF across Workers, Attendance, Products, Sales, Sales_Items, Business_Day, Operational_Expenses, Sale_Adjustments, Daily_Reconciliation.
Business Day Model: Each business date has an opening cash float, status (Open/Closed), and owns all sales, expenses, adjustments and one reconciliation snapshot.
Atomic Sales: AFTER INSERT trigger on Sales_Items deducts stock from Products.Current_Stock; rejects oversold lines; rolls back entire sale on any failure.
Adjustments: Sale_Adjustments preserves original receipt, restores stock for entry errors, records refunds through original channel, respects closed-date immutability.
Reconciliation: CloseDay locks Business_Day row in one InnoDB transaction; validates cash count and explanation; saves snapshot and Closed status atomically.
Views: Daily_Payment_Activity groups by business date and channel; URA_Summary separates recorded VAT from adjustments; Owner-only views for Total_Profit and Tax_Liability.

items: Conclusion: The DCMS architecture is directly driven by the operational bottlenecks observed at Deniz Construction Limited. Every functional requirement maps to a specific database entity, trigger, or stored procedure.
Next Steps: Deployment of the system on the existing office laptop, accompanied by a simplified User Manual for the Sales Manager.
Future Enhancements: advanced logistics tracking are logged in a Future Enhancements Backlog for post academic implementation.
